fixes: Native construction remains private: strict frames use the existing armed empty-reason fence, ready/scheduled public status, and private scanner refusal traces.
The exact no-argument agent recover command owns admission and refreshes the Commands panel; ordinary and restore-pending in-flight states refuse, while post-finalize recovery remains reachable.
Restore controls project visible/enabled/in-flight state, bind fallback timers to nonce/load/attempt, reject stale timers, and hide after a successful ordinary restore load.
Construct and restore-load publication are transactional: first publication must succeed, failures detach scripts, hide partial textures, clear bytes, and retain a failed restore path.
Both controls use UIPanelButtonTemplate and the harness models templates, enabled state, hidden-click refusal, and deterministic partial texture errors.
Marker and lifecycle matrix, strict frame decode lifecycle, pre-load refusals, release expiry, ordinary publication failures, and restore boundaries are covered by real harness callbacks.
limitations: Native client button-template availability and live callback/pixel qualification remain future live gates; this round uses the existing offline WoW harness and compiled atlas fixture only.
No service, daemon/helper, GUI, deployment, or live game changes were made.
